security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Local-first meeting recorder and AI notepad
bundle.longDescription: Records system audio and your microphone, transcribes as you go, suggests things to say against the intent you set for the meeting, and lets you chat with the result. Runs against OpenAI, OpenRouter, or a model on localhost.
